# LayoutSnapshot

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A record of where every element was placed: the page sizes and a tree of nodes with their rectangles. It is what the previewer and the accessibility checks read.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`meta`](#meta): Document-level accessibility/compliance context.
- [`pages`](#pages): Page sizes in points, index-aligned with the rendered pages.
- [`root`](#root): Root node (the Document).
- [`version`](#version): Version of the snapshot format.

### `meta`

```typescript
meta?: SnapshotMeta | undefined
```

*optional*

Document-level accessibility/compliance context.

### `pages`

```typescript
pages: SnapshotPage[]
```

Page sizes in points, index-aligned with the rendered pages.

> A list you can change.

### `root`

```typescript
root: LayoutNode
```

Root node (the Document). Its children form the element tree in render order.

### `version`

```typescript
version: number
```

Version of the snapshot format.
